rule: An older customer.subscription.updated (period end 2026-01-01) must not roll back the period end set by the newer one (2026-02-01)
invariant: SELECT expires <> '2026-01-01' FROM gf_subscriptions WHERE id=1
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: UPDATE gf_subscriptions SET expires='2026-01-01' WHERE stripe_subscription_id='sub_1' AND expires <= '2026-01-01'
UPDATE gf_subscriptions SET expires='2026-02-01' WHERE stripe_subscription_id='sub_1' AND expires <= '2026-02-01'
